free_tier_limits.correction: The GraphQL API is included in Starter. Account and event-page creation have no upfront charge, but paid ticket sales incur service and processing fees; free events have no service fees. No API-call allowance is published.

example.correction: Use the documented REST listings resource, for example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN" "https://www.universe.com/api/v2/listings?user_id=<host_id>". The submitted /events path and {"events":[]} response are not supported by the current REST documentation.

description.correction: Current documentation supports retrieving event, attendee, and sales data and mutations such as creating discount codes or access keys and checking in tickets. It does not substantiate API-based event creation or general ticket-inventory updating.

notes: The API and documentation remain live in 2026. The decisive error is the example: Universe's REST collection is /api/v2/listings, while current event-oriented examples primarily use POST https://universe.com/graphql. The entry also overstates documented write capabilities.
